In addition to clothing and accessories, they also offer a carefully curated selection of groceries. With an emphasis on high quality and healthy products, the Label Store's grocery section is a favorite among health conscious shoppers. From fresh produce to pantry staples, the Label Store ensures that all of their products meet strict quality standards. With a dedication to offering an unparalleled shopping experience, the Label Store has become a one-stop-shop for customers looking for fashion forward clothing, stylish accessoriesand wholesome groceries.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Accounts Executive

Job Location: Surulere, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are looking for a responsible and experienced Accounts Executive to assist in managing the company’s financial records, reporting, reconciliations, and day-to-day accounting activities.
	The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of accounting principles and the ability to provide accurate financial information to support management decisions.


Key Responsibilties


	Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, including Profit & Loss Statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow Statements.
	Prepare accurate and timely financial statements, management reports, and budgets.
	Generate financial reports and analysis to support management decision-making.
	Develop and maintain effective accounting policies and internal controls.
	Manage Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
	Monitor cash flow, expenses, revenues, and other financial activities.
	Maintain accurate records of all financial transactions, including sales, purchases, receipts, and payments.
	Reconcile daily sales and bank statements.
	Ensure proper documentation and filing of financial records.


Requirements


	Minimum of a B.Sc. or HND in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
	Proven experience in an accounting or finance role, preferably as an Accountant, Senior Accountant, Head of Accounts, or Finance Manager.
	Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, budgeting, and reconciliations.
	Proficiency in accounting software such as Retailman, QuickBooks, Sage, or similar accounting systems.
	Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
	Good communication and organisational skills.
	ICAN/ACCA certification or part-qualification is an added advantage.
	Previous experience in the retail or supermarket industry will be an added advantage.


Salary
N250,000 - N350,000 monthly.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Procurement & Inventory Officer",
  "description": "Java Design Concepts Ltd is a company that has more than 20 year&rsquo;s experience in the construction industry &amp; are dedicated to deliver in various services in the construction sectors, from Residential, Commercial buildings, high-rise buildings, road construction to Oil &amp; Gas Infrastructures as well as steel fabrication &amp; Concrete solutions. Our ability to handle any type of construction projects gives us the strength and permits our client to push boundaries with a peace of mind. Our infinite expertise &amp; resources span across the region with our integrity &amp; obsession of completing the job correctly, on time &amp; on budget has been our recipe for success.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Procurement &amp; Inventory Officer
